'''Mikkelin Palloilijat''' (or '''MP''') is a Finnish professional [[football (soccer)|football]] club, based in [[Mikkeli]], that competes in the [[Ykkösliiga]], the second tier in the [[Finnish football league system]]. The club was founded in 1929 and also included volleyball, bandy and ice hockey divisions."}}
